stem.text: A ball is held above the ground and released. It falls to the ground and bounces several times.
The graph shows the variation with time $t$ of the velocity $v$ of the ball.

stem.alt: Graph of velocity v on the vertical axis against time t on the horizontal axis, showing a series of straight line segments, with points P, Q, R and S labelled on the graph.

stem.text: Four points on the graph are labelled P, Q, R and S.

A.text: The area under line PQ represents the initial height of the ball.

B.text: The collisions of the ball with the ground are inelastic.

C.text: The gradient of the line RS represents the acceleration due to free fall.

D.text: The maximum upwards velocity of the ball is reached at point P.
